cohort: A single 9-year-6-month-old girl who first exhibited symptoms of multiple sclerosis at 30 months.
finding: The case highlights the challenging mission of reaching a definitive multiple sclerosis diagnosis in toddler-onset cases and the importance of recognizing hidden dynamics like smoldering MS for early high-efficacy treatment.
followup_time: From 30 months (symptom onset) until 9 years and 6 months of age.
